subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Hit the roof
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. To become very angry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"hit the roof"** means to become very angry or furious. (बहुत गुस्सा होना)

 
 
• **Example: **When he saw the mess his children had made, he hit the roof.
 
 
 
• **"To become very angry" **refers to a state of intense irritation or rage. (बहुत गुस्सा होना)
 
 
• **Example: **She hit the roof when she found out that her project was rejected without any valid reason.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. To become very angry**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To destruct a building** (एक इमारत को नष्ट करना): Refers to demolishing or tearing down a structure.

 
 
• **Example:** The old mall was destructed to make way for a new park.
 
 
 
• **To jump high** (ऊंची छलांग लगाना): Refers to leaping or springing upwards to a great height.
 
 
• **Example: **The athlete trained hard to jump high in the upcoming competition.
 
 
 
• **To play joyfully** (खुशी से खेलना): Refers to engaging in playful activities with delight and happiness.
 
 
• **Example:** The children played joyfully in the park during their break.
